content.short: Project X is a zero-fee decentralized exchange on HyperEVM.
content.description: Project X trades on HyperEVM with no swap fees, earning instead through other parts of its design, and is among the more active exchanges on the chain by value locked. Zero-fee trading shifts where a venue makes its money rather than removing the cost, so the question for users becomes what the exchange does with order flow instead.
